result.finding: The application uses Spring profiles with 2 active profiles ('dev' and '!dev' / production), plus an optional 'backup' profile. Profile selection switches between local file storage (dev) and AWS S3 (non-dev). No profile-specific property files exist; all configuration is in a single application.properties. The dev profile is explicitly activated via -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev in startapp.sh.
evidence: web/LocalFileStorageService.java: @Profile('dev') — active only in dev profile, uses local filesystem storage at '../storage'
web/AwsS3Service.java: @Profile('!dev') — active in all non-dev profiles, uses AWS S3
worker/LocalFileProcessingService.java: @Profile('dev') — local file processing in dev
worker/S3FileProcessingService.java: @Profile('!dev') — S3 file processing in non-dev
scripts/startapp.sh: -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev activates dev profile for both web and worker
No application-dev.properties or application-prod.properties files found — single application.properties for all profiles
values: dev profile: local filesystem storage, no S3 dependency
backup profile: enables BackupMessageProcessor AMQP listener
No profile-specific property files — single application.properties
